entities.summary: Giorgio Bertin is an Italian Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Djibouti since 2001 and Apostolic Administrator of the Diocese of Mogadishu since 1990. He is a member of the Order of Friars Minor. Giorgio Bertin was a religious figures from Galzignano Terme (b. 1946-12-28, Galzignano Terme). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
